-- Contrato principal: colunas de importacao do tax_rules.
-- Contrato estendido: colunas auxiliares de DIFAL/FCP para evolucao do motor.

WITH BASE_RULES AS (
    SELECT
        ICM.*,
        NVL(UFO.UF, 'ANY') AS UFORIGEM_RES,
        NVL(UFD.UF, 'ANY') AS UFDESTINO_RES,
        PRO.NCM AS NCM_PRODUTO,
        PRO.CODESPECST AS CEST_PRODUTO,
        NCM1.CODNCM AS NCM_RESTR_1,
        NCM2.CODNCM AS NCM_RESTR_2

requestBody.sql:
-- Consulta de referencia para alimentar o motor de tributacao do SFA.
-- Contrato principal: colunas de importacao do tax_rules.
-- Contrato estendido: colunas auxiliares de DIFAL/FCP para evolucao do motor.

WITH BASE_RULES AS (
    SELECT
        ICM.*,
        NVL(UFO.UF, 'ANY') AS UFORIGEM_RES,
        NVL(UFD.UF, 'ANY') AS UFDESTINO_RES,
        PRO.NCM AS NCM_PRODUTO,
        PRO.CODESPECST AS CEST_PRODUTO,
        NCM1.CODNCM AS NCM_RESTR_1,
        NCM2.CODNCM AS NCM_RESTR_2,

        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(ICM.ALIQUOTA), '')), ',', '.'), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.ALIQUOTA)), ',', '.'))
            ELSE 0
        END AS ALIQUOTA_NUM,

        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(ICM.ALIQINTDEST), '')), ',', '.'), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.ALIQINTDEST)), ',', '.'))
            ELSE 0
        END AS ALIQINTDEST_NUM,

        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(ICM.ALIQSUBTRIB), '')), ',', '.'), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.ALIQSUBTRIB)), ',', '.'))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ALIQSUBTRIB_NUM,

        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(ICM.PERCICMSFCP), '')), ',', '.'), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.PERCICMSFCP)), ',', '.'))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS PERCICMSFCP_NUM,

        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(ICM.PERCICMSFCPINT), '')), ',', '.'), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                THEN TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.PERCICMSFCPINT)), ',', '.'))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS PERCICMSFCPINT_NUM
    FROM TGFICM ICM
    LEFT JOIN TSIUFS UFO
        ON ICM.UFORIG = UFO.CODUF
    LEFT JOIN TSIUFS UFD
        ON ICM.UFDEST = UFD.CODUF
    LEFT JOIN TGFPRO PRO
        ON TO_CHAR(ICM.TIPRESTRICAO) IN ('P', '1')
       AND ICM.CODRESTRICAO = PRO.CODPROD
    LEFT JOIN TGFNCM NCM1
        ON TO_CHAR(ICM.TIPRESTRICAO) IN ('N', '4')
       AND LTRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.CODRESTRICAO), '0') = LTRIM(REPLACE(NCM1.CODNCM, '.', ''), '0')
    LEFT JOIN TGFNCM NCM2
        ON TO_CHAR(ICM.TIPRESTRICAO2) IN ('N', '4')
       AND LTRIM(TO_CHAR(ICM.CODRESTRICAO2), '0') = LTRIM(REPLACE(NCM2.CODNCM, '.', ''), '0')
    WHERE
        ICM.DTINICIOVIGENCIA IS NULL
        OR ICM.DTINICIOVIGENCIA <= SYSDATE
)
SELECT
    'active' AS STATUS,

    CASE
        WHEN TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO) IN ('N', '4')
             AND TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO) NOT IN ('-1', '0')
            THEN NCM_RESTR_1
        WHEN TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO2) IN ('N', '4')
             AND TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO2) NOT IN ('-1', '0')
            THEN NCM_RESTR_2
        WHEN TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO) IN ('P', '1')
             AND TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO) NOT IN ('-1', '0')
            THEN NCM_PRODUTO
        ELSE NULL
    END AS NCM,

    CEST_PRODUTO AS CEST,
    UFORIGEM_RES AS UFORIGEM,
    UFDESTINO_RES AS UFDESTINO,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(PAUTAVLRSTFIXO), '')) NOT IN ('', '0', '0,0', '0,00', '0.0', '0.00', 'N') THEN 'pmc'
        ELSE 'mva'
    END AS TIPOST,

    TO_CHAR(NULL) AS PRECOPARACALCULOST,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(REDBASEST), '')) IN ('', 'N') THEN '0'
        ELSE TO_CHAR(REDBASEST)
    END AS REDUCAOBASEICMSST,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(PAUTAVLRSTFIXO), '')) IN ('', 'N') THEN '0'
        ELSE TO_CHAR(PAUTAVLRSTFIXO)
    END AS BASECALCULOICMSST,

    TO_CHAR(NVL(ALIQSUBTRIB_NUM, NVL(ALIQINTDEST_NUM, ALIQUOTA_NUM))) AS ALIQUOTADESTINO,
    TO_CHAR(NVL(ALIQUOTA_NUM, ALIQINTDEST_NUM)) AS ALIQUOTACREDITO,

    -- DIFAL da regra: max(aliq interna destino - aliq interestadual/propria, 0)
    TO_CHAR(GREATEST(NVL(ALIQINTDEST_NUM, 0) - NVL(ALIQUOTA_NUM, 0), 0)) AS ALIQUOTADIFAL,

    TO_CHAR(CSOSN) AS CST_CSOSN,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(MVAORIGINAL), '')) NOT IN ('', 'N') THEN TO_CHAR(MVAORIGINAL)
        WHEN TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(MVASIMPLIFICADO), '')) NOT IN ('', 'N') THEN TO_CHAR(MVASIMPLIFICADO)
        ELSE '0'
    END AS MVA,

    (
        'TIPRESTRICAO=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO), '-') ||
        ';CODRESTRICAO=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO), '-') ||
        ';TIPRESTRICAO2=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO2), '-') ||
        ';CODRESTRICAO2=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO2), '-') ||
        ';TIPCALCDIFAL=' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TIPCALCDIFAL), '-')
    ) AS EXCECAOFISCAL,

    DTINICIOVIGENCIA AS VIGENCIAINICIAL,
    DTFIMVIGENCIA AS VIGENCIAFINAL,

    TO_CHAR(
        CASE
            WHEN TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO) IN ('P', '1')
                 AND TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO) NOT IN ('-1', '0')
                THEN 300000 + NVL(SEQUENCIA, 0)
            WHEN TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO) IN ('N', '4')
                 AND TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO) NOT IN ('-1', '0')
                THEN 200000 + NVL(SEQUENCIA, 0)
            WHEN TO_CHAR(TIPRESTRICAO2) IN ('N', '4')
                 AND TO_CHAR(CODRESTRICAO2) NOT IN ('-1', '0')
                THEN 190000 + NVL(SEQUENCIA, 0)
            ELSE 100000 + NVL(SEQUENCIA, 0)
        END
    ) AS PRIORIDADE,

    -- Colunas estendidas para evolucao do motor e reconciliacao.
    TO_CHAR(CODTRIB) AS GRUPOFISCALID,
    TO_CHAR(CODTAB) AS CODTAB,
    TO_CHAR(SEQUENCIA) AS SEQUENCIA,
    TO_CHAR(IDALIQ) AS IDALIQ,
    TO_CHAR(TIPCALCDIFAL) AS TIPOCALCULODIFAL,
    TO_CHAR(NVL(PERCICMSFCPINT_NUM, PERCICMSFCP_NUM)) AS PERCENTUALFCP,
    TO_CHAR(FORMCALFCPDIFAL) AS FORMULAFCPDIFAL,
    TO_CHAR(CODFORMCALCDIFAL) AS FORMULADIFAL

FROM BASE_RULES
ORDER BY
    UFORIGEM,
    UFDESTINO,
    PRIORIDADE DESC,
    NCM,
    CEST
